text: The thought-provoking cartoon vividly depicts two students talking before a poster, with one remarking that unrelated lectures bring unexpected rewards.
In contrast, two pictures can present a sharp contrast between taking early action and delaying tasks until the last minute.
As is clearly revealed by the bar chart, the number of city parks surged remarkably from 406 in 2020 to 670 in 2022.
Meanwhile, the accompanying picture depicts a citizen smiling in a new fitness area, mirroring an improved urban environment.
Similarly, the table clearly illustrates striking changes in household appliance ownership between 2014 and 2023.
Specifically, air conditioners witnessed the sharpest surge from 75.2 to 145.9, while washing machines and refrigerators climbed steadily to 98.2 and 103.4 respectively.
These figures vividly reflect the steady upgrading of Chinese residents' living standards.
